## Claim & Evidence

**Claim:** 麝香 (shèxiāng) is a Chinese incense ingredient (animal-derived, not botanical) — musk, a musk deer (Moschus spp.) secretion — with an aroma profile of animalic, musky, sweet, warm. Most 'musk' today is synthetic.
